notes: v2 rebuild with the same rig as v1: root empty 'dragon_kid' at the feet; body/head/wing_l/wing_r/tail/leg_l/leg_r/arm_l/arm_r are direct children with the same joint positions as v1; bucket is a child of arm_r (origin at the handle grip); bucket_candy is a child of bucket (origin on the candy floor just under the rim); socket_bucket_light is a child of bucket at its centre. The exported nodes carry translations only (no rotation or scale). The onesie is felt_teal felt, with a pillowy cream felt belly patch sewn on with 16 dark stitches, a puffy light-teal hood rim stitched along its crest (20 stitches), chunky curved cream horns with felt collars, 3 crest spikes plus 2 back spikes, scalloped plush wings with piped ribs, a fat 12-sided tail with a cream underside stripe and 5 spikes, dark-teal felt boots on cream soles with toe nubs, and dark-teal mittens with thumbs. Face: big ink eyes with a teal lower glint and two white highlights, rosy cheeks, an open smile with a tongue and one tiny fang, and a brown fringe. A 5 degree curious head tilt is baked into the head mesh. The bucket is a lobed pumpkin-material shell with a real boolean-carved face (glow_jack walls) over a glow_jack_hot inner chamber, a dark candy floor near the rim, a twisted rope handle with knots, and a heap of 6 gumballs, 2 mini wrapped candies, a gold coin and a lollipop.
